scope: Author HOV-SG 3D segment-level feature mapping on 8 supplied-pose Replica observations (source frames 0,25,...175) from the staged 40-frame subset. Hierarchical floor/room graph, semantic benchmark accuracy and navigation are not evaluated.
adaptations: 640x360 RGB/depth with separately rescaled intrinsics; SAM batching 36 and CLIP batching 4 for 12 GiB GPU; loader skip_frames=5 after the 40-observation merge process was killed. Segmentation/merging thresholds remain from the pinned author configuration.
